def search(nums):
    # Assumes sorted input where every value appears twice except one.
    # Pairs start at even indices before the single element and at odd indices after it.
    lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if mid % 2 == 1:
            mid -= 1  # align to the start of a pair
        if nums[mid] == nums[mid + 1]:
            lo = mid + 2  # the single element is to the right
        else:
            hi = mid  # the single element is at mid or to the left
    return nums[lo]


assert search([1, 1, 2, 2, 3]) == 3
assert search([1, 2, 2, 3, 3]) == 1
assert search([1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4]) == 4
assert search([1]) == 1
